purpose: Field registry for the Super-resolution Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates segmentation-free factorization, histology-guided reconstruction, graph fusion, deep data fusion, large-area reconstruction, and high-density generation.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes already high-density/submicron data from spot-plus-histology, sparse-input generation, and large-tissue reconstruction routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Super-resolution.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the resolution-enhancement, high-density generation, reconstruction, or factorization role; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps cross-task methods scoped to the Super-resolution analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as super-resolved expression map, pseudo-single-cell map, high-density profile, or factor map.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes inferred expression, tissue architecture, generated high-density profiles, and factor annotations.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger tissue scale, higher spatial density, or whole-section reconstruction.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps decide whether large slides or high-resolution reconstructions should avoid a method first.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support. Use unclear when no primary link is verified in the frozen input or bounded retrieval.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed by the frozen input or bounded verification pass.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or community-use evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, risk, and code-access uncertainty as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Resolution Target
fields.definition: Primary resolution-enhancement target addressed by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Prefer the method's main claimed target over downstream applications.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates factorization, tissue-architecture, single-cell/pseudo-cell, tumor, large-area, and high-density-generation branches.

fields.name: Image Signal Use
fields.definition: Whether histology or image-derived signal is central to method selection in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use none, optional, required, or unclear. Required means the method's topic role depends on matched image signal.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes histology-guided super-resolution from expression/spatial-only high-density or factorization routes.

fields.name: External Reference Dependence
fields.definition: Whether the method depends on external references beyond the ST sample and optional matched image.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Histology from the same sample does not by itself count as an external reference.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights reference-bias and missing-reference constraints.

fields.name: Output Geometry
fields.definition: Spatial geometry of the main output relevant to selection.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise phrase describing output geometry rather than a data schema.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents conflating grids, factors, pseudo-cells, cellular-level maps, and generated ST profiles.

fields.name: Cellular Reconstruction Mode
fields.definition: Dominant conceptual route from original spatial measurement to higher-resolution output.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value matching the method's main branch role.
fields.topic_relevance: Gives the decision tree a branch-local mechanism cue without claiming implementation details.

fields.name: Signal-risk Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about over-smoothing, morphology bias, generated-expression hallucination, pseudo-cell certainty, scale masking, or related scientific risks.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score unless later evidence justifies that.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit in method selection.
